official_sources.source_identity: Direct live Gravity Flow changelog retrieved by the exact-head radar; first version heading is 3.1.1 dated 2026-08-25

capability_observations.summary: The current live 3.1.1 release explicitly changes GravityView integration to address deprecated filters used for Workflow Detail and Approval Links. This is ecosystem contract evidence, not proof of a PersianGravity regression or repair.

PersianGravity's four Entry Detail workflow-info dates intentionally retain an exact Owner-supplied Gravity Flow package gate because the shared date-format seam lacks semantic row identity. Any Owner-supplied post-3.1.0 package must follow the existing CURRENT_METHOD_STILL_VALID / SAFE_REPLACEMENT_FOUND / NO_SAFE_PATH_PROVEN requalification protocol.
